name: Root1_A
description: Level one forest root obstacle: one stout low cut stump with two or three thick twisting roots wrapped close around its base, compact nearly square footprint, deep brown warm bark in broad connected planes, pale endgrain in a single readable cut plane, sparse mossy olive green leaf cluster. description: Level one forest root obstacle variant B: one large chunky bent root knot curling over itself into a low compact square mound, broad warm bark planes and deep creases, a snapped lighter wooden tip, two sparse dark olive leaf clusters. name: Vines_A

Full-cell diagonal woven growth, NOT an empty wreath or border. Broad connected 2-3-tone foliage clusters, near-black contours, muted mossy olive and warm bark. No background, no gem.

name: Vines_B
description: A dense forest vine overlay for one square match-3 gem cell: a tangled lattice of thick curling rootlike vines horizontally and vertically crossing the center, broad dark green leaves gathered along two intersections and small ivory thorns. name: Root2_A

name: Root2_B
description: Level two forest root obstacle variant B: a dense tightly interwoven double knot of TWO large bent roots, one horizontal and one hooked upright, three broad crossing root bands enclosing a solid woody center.
